title: BUGFIX — Fix daily digest Telegram Markdown parsing error
description: Daily digest fails since Mar 20 with 'can't parse entities' error. Root cause: escapeMd() only strips <> but doesn't escape *, _, `, [, ] in dynamic content. Fix escapeMd and add fallback to plain text on Markdown parse failure.

tasks.title: Fix escapeMd() to properly escape Telegram Markdown V1 special chars
Add fallback: retry sendTelegram without parse_mode on Markdown failure
Create validate-digest-markdown.ts to verify no parse errors
